text:
ellie (product): quick thread 102: need alignment on 'Delta' private-tenant pilot (prewarm + KMS + tight p95). customers asking for predictable latency & explicit fallback policy. inputs: launch criteria, owners for infra/reserve, runtime gating plan, security checklist. call out obvious blockers please.

ralph (sales-se): customer wants failover-to-hosted opt-in, clear SLA handoff doc, and an estimate of extra monthly cost for reserved capacity.

ben (eng-infra): capacity short: to hit p95 we should reserve 6 x A100 equiv for pilot window. will need billing owner signoff. also we should allocate a dedicated node label `delta-pilot=true`. 3-day lead after signoff.

chao (eng-runtime): runtime blockers: prewarm thread touches hot path; implement as feature-flag first. need metrics: prefix_hit, warmness header, and cold_start_ms. estimate 3 weeks for safe rollout (flag + telemetry + bench harness).

mira (security): security asks: KMS key policy, HSM attestation doc, audit events for fallback, and rotation runbook. on-prem tenants must have HSM before pilot begins.

ellie (product): propose minimal launch criteria: 1) reserved infra in place, 2) KMS smoke test green, 3) perf harness: p95 <=150ms for <=512 tokens steady, cold-start <=450ms, 4) audit logs enabled + runbook. reasonable?

chao (eng-runtime): p95 150ms looks achievable for quantized variants with warmed prefixes. cold-start 450ms is safer than 300ms. will add bench tag `delta.pilot` to results.

ben (eng-infra): confirm reserve pending billing. also we must ensure autoscaler excludes `delta-pilot` nodePool. I'll open ticket.

lily (prod-ops): I'll be billing owner if finance OK. please put expected cost in ticket. also need rollback criteria: spike in fallback egress >1% or p95 regress >20% => pause.

mira (security): drafting checklist. adding requirement: fallback disabled by default for tenants with `compliance=high`. will need legal signoff for audit retention >90d.

ralph (sales-se): request: dashboard hook so customers see fallback events (reason + time). not required for pilot but high priority for GA.

chao (eng-runtime): small snippet we'll add to enable prewarm behind flag:
```
feature_flags: { "delta_prewarm": false }
headers: { "x-warmness": "0|partial|warm" }
```
will push three PRs: flag, metrics, bench harness.

ben (eng-infra): infra ticket id: INF-4123 (reservation request). includes node label, rack preference, and exclusion policy. pinging @lily for finance.

lily (prod-ops): ack, will review INF-4123. please add expected pilot dates and 24/7 on-call rotation for pilot week.

mira (security): adding HSM attestation checklist + key rotation runbook to SEC-2207. attaching to INF-4123 once ready.

ci-bot: pipeline:delta-prewarm scheduled; will start bench job once chao marks bench:ready.

chao (eng-runtime): next steps: I'll create three tickets (FLAG-1, METRICS-2, BENCH-3) by EOD tomorrow. aim to have bench green before scheduling canary.

ellie (product): thanks. lily/ben/mira please confirm dates in this thread. I'll assemble sequencing storyboard and post tomorrow morning. sync optional at 10:30. :calendar:
